notes: Per-contract WASM size budgets for the Tessera Soroban workspace. The Soroban contract size limit is 65,536 bytes; the 85% warning threshold (55,705 bytes) drives the near-limit code-size issue. Every workspace member defaults to the hard limit until measured evidence justifies a tighter per-contract budget. The tessera-no-std utility crate is an rlib (no WASM artifact) and is intentionally not listed here. Update this file together with .github/workflows/wasm-size.yml and contracts/scripts/check_wasm_size.py when adding new workspace members.
